project.name: Voyager LR Modification Programme 'RENEW'
project.description: Mid-life modification programme for the in-service Voyager LR fleet: retire diminishing-manufacturing-source (DMSMS) obsolescence in the avionics suite and deliver a fuel-burn performance improvement retrofit, both governed by a shared aircraft architecture baseline.

properties.gate_criteria: Certification evidence complete; fleet embodiment can start.
properties.name: Fleet Retrofit Readiness Review

properties.success_criterion: Every avionics LRU on the obsolescence watch list has a qualified replacement or a documented last-time-buy by FRR.
properties.name: Retire all identified DMSMS obsolescence risk items

properties.success_criterion: Flight-test-correlated analysis demonstrates at least 1.5% fuel-burn reduction relative to the pre-modification baseline.
properties.name: Achieve a fuel-burn reduction at the typical mission profile

properties.success_criterion: Non-recurring cost within 10% of the approved budget at CDR.
properties.name: Keep retrofit-kit non-recurring cost within budget

properties.success_criterion: Certification compliance data package accepted by FRR with no open findings.
properties.name: Certify the modification for fleet-wide retrofit
